answers.why_first_set_is_late: elig() needs 120 consecutive non-missing closes measured inside the start window, so no decision before index 120 can hold anything: the first possible invested bar is the session after the first month end at or past index 120

honest: the burn-in is a property of the engine's membership rule, not a data defect: the same 120-bar rule gates every scheme
warm slices pay the burn-in on bars outside the measured span; the naive columns are the same spec started cold, and the difference is the gate
symbols_in_universe counts de-duplicated panels; eligibility arrival is per window because the rule is window-relative
descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no prereg, no trial count
